## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (4)
- `GET /passport/safe/csrf_token/` — Obtain a CSRF token for authentication.
- `GET /ttwid/union/register/callback/` — Handle callback after TTWID union registration.
- `POST /ttwid/union/register/` — Register a new TTWID union.
- `POST /v1/user/webid` — Authenticate user and obtain web ID.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /business/` — Retrieve business-related data.
- `POST /api/v3/ip.json` — Retrieve IP address information.
- `POST /v1/list` — Retrieve a list of items.

### Data Write (6)
- `POST /{id}` — Update data for a specific item by ID.
- `POST /api/attrib/trace/init/` — Initialize attribution tracing.
- `POST /api/v4/i18n/optimizer/message/` — Optimize internationalization messages.
- `POST /mssdk/web_common` — Send common web data via MS SDK.
- `POST /ttwid/{ttwidId}/` — Update data associated with a specific TTWID.
- `POST /web/report` — Submit a web report.

### Media (1)
- `GET /web/resource` — Retrieve a web resource (e.g., image).

### Config (4)
- `GET /api/v1/web-cookie-privacy/config` — Get privacy configuration for web cookies.
- `GET /monitor_web/settings/browser-settings` — Get browser settings for monitoring.
- `GET /wi/config/10204935.json` — Retrieve a specific configuration file.
- `POST /vc/setting` — Update video call settings.
